chatbot.name: TSA Bot
chatbot.welcomeMessage: Hello! I'm your TSA Logistics assistant. I can help you with your missions, shipment tracking, our shop and much more. How can I assist you?
chatbot.helpMessage:
Here's what I can do for you:
• Transport mission management
• Real-time tracking
• Refurbished parts shop
• Support and assistance

Feel free to ask me your questions!

responses.missions: I can help you with transport mission management. You can create a new mission, track your ongoing missions, or check your mission history in the 'Missions' section.
responses.tracking: For mission tracking, go to the 'Tracking' section where you can see real-time position of your transporters and delivery progress status.
responses.boutique: In our shop, you'll find quality refurbished parts. You can browse categories, add items to your cart and place orders easily.
responses.vehicles: For fleet management, you can add your vehicles, update their information and track their availability in the 'Vehicles' section.
responses.support: I'm here to help! You can ask me questions about using the TSA Logistics platform. For advanced technical support, contact our team via the 'Contact' section.
responses.greeting: Hello! I'm the TSA Logistics assistant. I can help you with transport missions, shipment tracking, our refurbished parts shop, and much more. How can I assist you today?
responses.default: I'm the TSA Logistics assistant and I can help you with various platform features: mission management, shipment tracking, refurbished parts shop, and general support. What would you like to know?
